headline: Is something holding me here alone, or is this just my life now?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The pictures were hidden, but your hand found the one with a full table.
A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand are all laid out.
You asked whether something holds you alone or this is simply your life. What catches me is the full table.
You are alone now, and the question has grown large enough to describe your life.
Something reaches the question just where possibility would become connection. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see the card, yet you reached for the one with room around the restraint.
One ankle is held. The rest of the figure hangs free.
You asked whether you are held here. This card makes me look at how small the restraint is beside the whole figure.
Still, connection is absent, and you are asking whether the hold is permanent.
Something sits between the free space and the relationship. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs were identical, but your hand went to the one carrying little.
One small bundle is tied to the stick over his shoulder.
You asked whether solitude is your life now. The light bundle brings me to what the Fool carries forward.
But you are alone, and the road ahead feels as though it carries the same answer.
Whatever has hold of this keeps the question narrowed to one answer. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of the question…
